name: Blooming Panic
source:
Depressed day-in and day-out from a draining corporate job, you become invested in a fantasy webnovel and find a mysterious link to a fan server. Everyone is warm and welcoming, but four members take a special interest in you!

[From [url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/blooming-panic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于公司工作让人精疲力尽，日复一日地感到沮丧，你开始沉迷于一本奇幻网络小说，并发现了一个与粉丝服务器的神秘链接。每个人都热情好客，但有四位成员对你特别感兴趣！

[来自[url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/blooming-panic]Itch.io[/url]]
